updateInstructions: Edit only the "status" (and optionally "note") field on a task when real work happens. Valid statuses: not-started, in-progress, complete, blocked. tasks.label: Partial Mentor Control Tower — caseload count + session-frequency signals only
tasks.note: Blueprint 08 Part One, Section Three (the instrument); Blueprint 11 Section Eleven (the compensation firewall); Blueprint 04 Part Thirteen (the reused cadence numbers). New REGIONAL_STEWARD RoleType value (sixteenth, added to Blueprint 08 Part Four Section Five's original fifteen) + grantRegionalSteward (src/modules/identity/regional-steward.ts, Administrator-granted, no attestation ceremony — governance names none for this office). getMentorControlTowerRollup (src/modules/identity/mentor-control-tower.ts): two real signals — active caseload count against MENTOR_CASELOAD_CEILING (countActiveMentorCaseloadTx, extracted from mentor-assignment.ts so the Control Tower, assignMentorTx, and findMentorWithCapacityTx all share one counting implementation) and a per-Mentor rollup of overdue Mentor check-ins (isMentorCheckInDueTx + MENTOR_CHECK_IN_INTERVAL_DAYS, extracted from weekly-reflection.ts, reusing the exact cadence numbers rather than reinventing them). No strain score, threshold, or alert — raw numbers only, since governance names no numeric threshold anywhere. Firewalled structurally, not just documented: the rollup is a plain ephemeral array, persisted nowhere, with no compensation module anywhere in this codebase to FK into even if one wanted to. RLS mirrors the application-layer check via a new app_actor_is_regional_steward_of_mentor_role helper, region-scoping a Steward's own visibility on roles/mentor_assignments/mentor_session_transcripts. NOT marked complete: (1) no Blueprint 15 sampled-audit-results signal (control-tower-full, Phase 4, named in governance as a distinct later addition); (2) the region-proxy (Mentor's own circleId → Circle.regionId, applied symmetrically to the requesting Steward) is an explicitly named approximation, not a guarantee — Mentor assignment itself is not region-scoped anywhere in this codebase. See the openBlockers entry 'mentor-control-tower-region-proxy-gap'.

tasks.label: Mentor five-year rotation, operational workflow (renewal, handoff protocol)

MentorHandoff model + scheduleMentorHandoff/completeMentorHandoff (mentor-handoff.ts): captures Part Five's three named content fields, family-inclusion computed via onboard-learner.ts's own reused isMinor check, RLS scoped to the three named parties plus the learner's parent(s) for read, only the two named Mentor Roles for write, closed once complete. NOT marked complete: (1) the Disruption-pause check (hasActiveDisruptionTransition) is a caller-supplied boolean stand-in, not a real query — no Disruption-transition tracking exists anywhere in this codebase; (2) the handoff record is described in its own doc comment as modeled on, not identical to, Blueprint 04's Transition Conversation entity, which also doesn't exist in code; (3) Blueprint 11 Section Four's Circle One extended-first-term exception is not implemented (out of this task's own stated scope, and no Circle/Discovery-pathway-stage data exists to compute it against). See the openBlockers entry 'mentor-rotation-transition-framework-gap'.

Two are satisfied by this build: hardcoded diarize=false/mip_opt_out=true (TypeScript literal types + Object.freeze, src/modules/ai-gateway/five-to-thirteen-transcript-service.ts) and an LLM system-prompt guardrail against soliciting identifying details via voice (src/modules/ai-gateway/my-genie-tier-guardrails.ts). openBlockers.label: My Genie 13+ tier: 2 outstanding items, both Duncan's own procurement work — not legal review, which is complete.
openBlockers.detail: OPERATIONAL MANUALS/MY GENIE 13+ PIPELINE — FOLLOW-UP FIVE STILL-OPEN QUESTIONS — LEGAL BRIEFING FOR COUNSEL.md's 'Counsel's reply, received 2026-08-21' section: 'the top tier's legal review is now substantively complete... What remains before my-genie-thirteen-plus-pipeline can be built is procurement, not law: a consent-method vendor, and the same countersigned Deepgram DPA the 5-13 tier is also waiting on.' (1) A Verifiable Parental Consent (VPC) method vendor — DGENIE must contract with a provider of one of the FTC's more rigorous methods (knowledge-based authentication, a payment-card transaction, or the facial-recognition government-ID method); none is selected, and src/modules/ai-gateway/verifiable-parental-consent.ts's VerifiableParentalConsentProvider is built and tested only against a stub. (2) The countersigned Deepgram DPA — the same unsigned agreement already blocking the 5-13 tier (see 'my-genie-five-to-thirteen-remaining-prerequisites' above); the 13+ tier's own TTS/STT usage depends on the identical signature. Neither item is a build task — both are Duncan's own vendor-selection and contracting work.

openBlockers.label: Blueprint 04's general Transition framework has no manifest task and no code anywhere — Mentor rotation's Disruption-pause and handoff fidelity are best-effort, not verified against a real signal.
openBlockers.detail: Blueprint 04 Part Twenty-Four ('Learner Transition and Life Navigation') names six transition types, a general Transition entity, and the Transition Conversation format — none of it has a table, a module, or a manifest task in this codebase. The Mentor rotation task (mentor-rotation-operational) needs two pieces of it that don't exist: a real Disruption-transition signal to pause a scheduled rotation against (Blueprint 07 Part Five), and the Transition Conversation format the MentorHandoff record is supposed to be modeled on (src/modules/identity/mentor-handoff.ts). Built against honest stand-ins instead — hasActiveDisruptionTransition is a caller-supplied boolean with no real query behind it (mentor-rotation.ts's resolveMentorRotationDue), and MentorHandoff's own doc comment (schema.prisma) states plainly it is not a claim of fidelity to Blueprint 04's actual entity. Until the general Transition framework is scoped and built as its own task, any rotation-pause decision and any handoff record's resemblance to the governance-described format rest on whatever the calling code supplies, not on a verified platform signal.

openBlockers.label: No live mapping from a Mentor's caseload to a region exists anywhere in this codebase — the Control Tower's per-region scoping is an honestly-flagged proxy, not a guarantee.
openBlockers.detail: Blueprint 08 Part One, Section Three frames the Mentor Control Tower as a Regional Steward's own instrument, scoped to 'every Mentor in their region.' No RoleType or Role column carries a region; Mentor assignment itself (findMentorWithCapacityTx, src/modules/identity/mentor-assignment.ts) is platform-wide with no region filter, and this task's own non-goals explicitly forbid retrofitting it to be region-scoped. getMentorControlTowerRollup (src/modules/identity/mentor-control-tower.ts) stands in with a proxy instead: a Mentor's own User.circleId → Circle.regionId (the same relation Phase 2's community module built), applied symmetrically to the requesting Regional Steward's own circleId. This is real, working code — the RLS-layer app_actor_is_regional_steward_of_mentor_role helper (prisma/migrations/20260823090100_mentor_control_tower_rls) enforces the identical scoping at the database layer — but it is a proxy: a Mentor's own community-circle region is not necessarily the region of every individual learner on their caseload, since no per-learner region assignment exists either. Until Mentor assignment (or some other mechanism) actually carries a verified region, the Control Tower's own per-region rollup for a Regional Steward is only as accurate as this proxy, and a Mentor with no circleId at all is simply invisible to every Regional Steward (fails closed, not open — but still an honest gap, not a finished mapping).

openBlockers.label: M3 (COPPA/biometric review) researched 2026-08-17; needs qualified legal counsel before My Genie's pipeline proceeds. M6, M8 still fully open.
openBlockers.detail: Full findings in OPERATIONAL MANUALS/MY GENIE VOICE PIPELINE -- LEGAL BRIEFING FOR COUNSEL.md: the FTC's amended COPPA Rule (effective 2026-04-22) makes voiceprints regulated personal information requiring separate parental consent; Illinois BIPA and similar state laws add independent exposure; the FTC has an open 6(b) inquiry into AI companion chatbots for minors. Duncan is retaining counsel; nothing in my-genie-full-pipeline proceeds until they sign off. M6 and M8 not yet raised again by Duncan.
